conditions: The statement is the documented EXEC form and its positional argument is interpreted under the corresponding form.
limitations: The source treats cataloged and in-stream procedures as distinct forms and lists special JES3 PGM values. The claim covers syntax and intended selection. Execution, availability of a program, procedure lookup and step limits have separate rules.

triggers: Publisher correction, exact edition or integrity discrepancy, or contrary JCL language evidence.

statement: The February 2025 reference uses EXEC to open a job step and select its program or procedure. An EXEC statement supplies one positional selector, PGM, PROC, or the procedure name, before its keyword parameters.
